pairs.subject: agent-memory
pairs.evidence: src/hooks/useModuleCLI.ts:260 The skill packs come from telemetry patterns mined from past sessions, so they are learned memory added to the prompt. When that lookup fails, through a non-ok response or a thrown error, it is dropped silently. A failed recall then looks exactly like an empty one, and neither the agent nor the operator can tell the two apart.

techniques.evidence: src/hooks/useModuleCLI.ts:260 The standard says a failed recall must be visibly different from an empty one. Here a failed skill-pack lookup (one of the learned patterns injected into the prompt) is swallowed and the dispatch looks normal.
src/hooks/useModuleCLI.ts:250 A non-ok response from the pattern store is turned into null and treated as 'no skills'. The read path quietly fails open to empty instead of degrading and saying so.
src/hooks/useModuleCLI.ts:215 Learned patterns are scoped to the current project explicitly. The comments at lines 213-214 note that the old unscoped read used to pull in another project's patterns.
